summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share and net investment income ranges as of June 30, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a routine interim NAV estimate, which is ordinary periodic disclosure for a closed-end fund. There are no deal terms, no board recommendations, no advisors named, and no structural changes. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
